The '''Shadow Fist Marksman''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] who served in the [[Shadow Fist]], the most elite unit in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the [[SpecForce Incident]], the Shadow Fist was deployed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] traitor [[Harron Tavus]] in an attempt to trap and eliminate his former unit, [[Havoc Squad]]. Havoc Squad was lured to a stealth ship in deep space, and the Shadow Fist ambushed the Republic [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]&mdash;but the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] squad survived the ambush, killing all five members of the Shadow Fist.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shadow Fist Marksman is one of the five members of the Shadow Fist who attack players during "The Shadow Fist," a class mission for the Trooper class in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
